bayts.text: You have restored my body for me, Lord of creation; You took away already before those who hated me with their (vain) play.
You ransomed me, Lord, in secret and openly; You removed Your enemies from me with the "never" (lan).
You have raised what of me appeared and what is hidden, illumining by grace my resting-place.
You have blessed for me what was revealed and what lay hidden, and my outward and my inward have found rest in You.
You have given me possession of what You chose for me, O Lord of time, and You have been for me without end with safety.
You gave me to drink a water joined to Your mystery; You fettered all my haters with a rope.
You have borne witness for me with what spared me the ordeals, O You Who filled my ark with Your outpouring.
You drew for me a secret that repelled the people of sedition, through the Caliphs, among them the lion, the son-in-law (ʿAlī).
You have benefited me through the Possessor of the obligations and the sunnas, the Companions and the angels: You made the favours immense.
You awakened me, You took sorrow away from me, O You toward Whom has turned from me what for me has come into balance.
The enemies fled, through him whom my Lord cursed, toward other than my harm; and my enemy was not helped.
He makes firm, safe from illnesses, the health of the body; and my Lord has repelled those who expelled me, with (their) vain play.
